title: North-star through4280: actual inheritance, body/continuity modes and current food baseline
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

ids: placement correction;heirs/legacy/fragments/legends/enemy methods;death/continuity and fourcarry kinds;lone-wolf/next-life plan table;persistence4layers/life loop;13 startingrealms/body spectrum;hunger6options+timedfood correction;immortal7routes;Primordial scout opening boundary
reviews.classification: cumulative north-star opening4280 lines; actual leftovers/continuity, local body modes and later ordinary-food direction
reviews.disposition:
Continuation of B446: another1,000 original lines,3,281–4,280, were freshly read in five contiguous200-line ranges. Cumulative original-input coverage is1–4,280, still partial;4,281–7,761 and appended notices remain open. This covers the placement correction, heirs/legacy/fragments/legends, succession and continuity/lone-wolf/next-life proposals, persistence/life loops, thirteen starting realms and body needs, the complete hunger discussion and immortal travel. It ends at the beginning of the Primordial Saint Sect scout section, whose later source corrections are not counted as reviewed here.

**The range contains its own direction corrections.** The cheat-placement section records that a universal no-rank rule was misattributed to the user: placement and comparison are retained, with mechanisms/backing/feats rather than one mandatory power ladder. Its brief portability summary is not a universal rule that knowledge must decay, soul/items always travel or world-backed powers can never be carried. The actual means decides. The old multiply-one-input/move-the-bottleneck/mandatory-world-pushback suggestions do not revoke pure cheats or genuine multiplied gains. Early one-realm/prestige references and death-as-first-prestige remain historical; even this range expressly allows indefinite life extension. Current [direction](USER_VISION.md), [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md), [cheat cosmology](CHEAT_COSMOLOGY.md) and [continuity palette](worlds/SUCCESSION_BY_WORLD.md) govern a selected slice.

**Inheritance preserves actual leftovers, not a compensating package.** Keep property, custody, will/claim, knowledge, social standing, soul continuity, fragments and third-party relationships distinct. Actual enemies and other claimants can affect what survives; their existence does not guarantee every inheritance is attacked. A rich inheritance need not receive envy or debt to balance it, and a poor one need not erase unrelated debts or grant anonymity. A refusal, split, theft, loss, return or inheritance claim has its actual owner and settlement. New characters can be related by blood, training, object, soul, story or nothing; the same human player does not grant an in-world carrier, legal claim or automatic trust. Conversely, continuity need not reset real relationships where actual people recognize and retain them. The explicit user correction that legends can be right qualifies the earlier tendency to make gossip always false.

**Next-life control is a local proposal, not an automatic reset tax.** The random-unless-planned discussion preserves weighted rolls, plans with different control and chosen-start modes. It does not turn better control into compulsory rising prices, every reincarnation into memory-only carry or every loop into soul scars/detectability. The same-world later succession, earlier rewind, new-body/world transition and meta option layers are distinct. A sealed/missing/ascended person is not necessarily dead. A lone-wolf life can use ordinary services, retain allies, choose no successor or continue through actual other carriers; the listed trust penalty, loneliness, no nursing and automatic freedom are possibilities, not guaranteed properties. Keep player knowledge separate from character knowledge without inventing a detectable trace merely because the human remembers.

**Bodies and modes differ by actual mechanisms.** Thirteen realm examples are useful ways to ask what actions, senses, needs and continuity a start has. Monster/object/plant/ghost/construct/divine/collective labels do not prove universal hunger, immobility, lack of rights, master dependence, belief dependence or maintenance. The range itself explicitly permits full robots, hybrid bodies, substitutions and need-removing cheats. Repair and healing are different mechanisms but a body can support both, including self-repair or rest-driven repair when actually supplied. Immortal travel may retain full power; a clone need not be weaker, a true self need not wait asleep, and starting low is one desired experience rather than every travel route's purpose. Switching focus and helping across bodies/worlds needs actual control, reach, time and custody without duplicating resources.

**Food has later owning direction.** Scoped review of the current [hunger/body-needs owner](HUNGER_AND_BODILY_NEEDS_CONSIDERATIONS_2026-10-13.md) confirms its linked user-direction fold: ordinary unfed play stays comfortable, food has useful benefits, hunger does not kill in that baseline, and Famine may gain positive passive progress during eligible underfed time. The withdrawn active-exertion-only suggestion is not restored. The north star's own correction already recognizes vanilla timed food buffs, so the earlier optional-well-fed-as-new proposal is historical. Auto-eat, rested bonuses, household upkeep, draining meters, compulsory variety and named-body need bars are separate proposals; do not add a penalty merely to give Famine something to cancel, silently consume rare stock, erase chosen underfed training or invent substitute hunger for a body that has no nutritional need. Eligible elapsed time and actual fractional progress count once; loading/toggling/rendering do not supply fresh progress. The scoped owner lookup is not a new build or current balance test.

The fresh-body/one-lesson status, module observations, source-dossier completion claims and concrete source mechanics in this range retain their dates and qualification limits. Linkage, a source label, proposed multi-timescale loop or a suggested body meter is not current implemented gameplay. Preserve all original options and examples without activating them by this review. Continue actual reading at4,281; no primary source/PDF, live worker, code, personal save, gameplay test/build/browser, acquisition, deletion, migration or commit was performed.
reviews.evidence: Prior1–3280 actual coverage retained in B444–B446; fresh3281–3480,3481–3680,3681–3880,3881–4080,4081–4280. Scoped current hunger owner paragraphs checked for food/passive-progression direction, not full new source/runtime review. Explicit cumulative partial coverage; next4281.
reviews.reopen: Continue actual content at4281 through original7761 and appended owner notices; qualify the coming Primordial scout/targeted-audit revisions before whole-file credit.
